card.text: Explore Dejopeja in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 175 shape model
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction. Selected archive volume-equivalent diameter: 93 ±9 km. An alternative pole remains possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 175 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 46.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
